Customs Act 1969: The Government is empowered under section 19(1) of this Act to issue notifications for the purpose of granting exemptions or amending customs-related provisions.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: The Government exercises its authority under section 14(1) of this Act, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend regulatory orders.
National Board of Revenue: This government body provides consultation to the Government for the issuance and amendment of customs and tax-related regulatory notifications.
S.R.O. 160-AIN/2012: This specific customs notification is being further amended by the current order to update the H.S. Code references within its established table.
H.S. Code: Several specific H.S. Code entries within the existing regulatory table are being replaced with updated classifications to ensure accurate categorization of imported goods.
TABLE: The table attached to the referenced notification is being modified to update listed H.S. Codes.
